description: Opt-in marketing email to up to 1,000 people who asked for it; each gets its own one-click unsubscribe link. Give each recipient's consent_source and consent_at (or confirm them first with an opt-in); a recipient without proof is skipped (no_consent_proof). No cold or bought lists. Invalid, role, blocked or unsubscribed recipients are skipped and cost nothing; each accepted recipient uses 1 email of the allowance as it goes out. The campaign is kept and sent one email at a time, at send_at, local_time + timezone or each recipient's own time; {{name}} fields take each recipient's vars. When today's marketing to a mail provider is full, those emails wait for the next UTC day.

from.description: Name before the @ (e.g. hello). The domain is always email59.com. Optional.

list_id.description: Your name for this audience, used for unsubscribes.

local_time.description: Instead of send_at: HH:MM in timezone, the next such time.

recipients.description: Recipient addresses, or objects with their own merge values and send time (max 1,000).

send_at.description: ISO 8601 with its offset; overrides the campaign's.

timezone.description: IANA name; alone it takes the campaign's local_time in this zone.

send_at.description: When it goes out: ISO 8601 with its offset, 1 minute to 30 days ahead. Empty = now.

name: send_campaign
title: Send a marketing campaign
